\\First Year Wellness Retreat - January 12 - 17, 2027\\  
  
Come spend a week learning and practicing the dimensions of wellness with other first year students. After early check-in on January 11, we head out to the mountains for a combination of movement/somatic practices through yoga and meditation, as well as connection with others and a deep dive into self-awareness of your personal wellness needs and support. There will also be opportunities for hiking and nature connection.
